strings.old: Perform a quick dash forward and immobilize and disarm an enemy with your weapon's pommel, preventing them from parrying.
strings.new: Perform a quick dash to the targeted enemy hero whose attack you deflected, damaging them with your weapon's pommel, knocking them back, slowing them and preventing stamina usage.

strings.old:
Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, immobilizing and disarming them, preventing them from parrying, and reducing their Melee Resist.

Press {g:citadel_binding:'Ability2'} to select a target.
Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
strings.new:
Prepare to deflect all incoming ability damage. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and gain the ability to dash to an enemy hero whose attack you deflected. Hitting them deals {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'SpiritDamage'}, knocks them back, applies {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'Slow'} and prevents stamina usage.

While deflecting, bullets are reflected back at the attacker.

Press {g:citadel_binding:'Ability2'} to counter attack.
Reflected bullets do not trigger the counter attack.

strings.old:
Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage or being Stunned, Immobilized, put to Sleep or Movement Silenced during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.

After teleporting, gain a Barrier.
strings.new:
Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage or being Stunned, Immobilized, put to Sleep or Movement Silenced during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.

After teleporting, gain a Barrier.

{g:citadel_binding:'AltCast'} to target your base's healing area.
Rejuvenation Credit can be spent by:
No living players can spend this Rejuvenation Credit.
Set up a private match and invite your friends
Enter a code to join an existing custom match
An enemy Abrams with Superior Duration uses Shoulder Charge at you and follows up with light and heavy melee attacks, then starts over
An enemy Baba chases you in Granny Long Legs form, moving side to side while using light and heavy melee attacks at random
An enemy Baba moves and jumps around while using Threadsap on you every few seconds
An enemy Bebop moves and jumps around while firing Grapple Arm at you every few seconds
An enemy Billy with Melee Charge closes in on you and uses Chain Gang into Bashdown and Rising Ram, follows up with a light and a heavy melee attack, then starts over
An enemy Danny takes off in front of you, overheats and dives at you, then starts over
An enemy Vindicta takes Flight in front of you and strafes side to side
An enemy Graves with Rebuttal summons a gravestone with Borrowed Decree and stands in it ready to parry. Bait out her parry, then destroy the gravestone with heavy melees
An enemy Grey Talon launches into the air with Rain of Arrows and shoots at you, sometimes firing a Charged Shot, then starts over
An enemy Holliday with Greater Expansion places a Bounce Pad, launches off it and throws a Powder Keg at you from the air, then starts over
An enemy Lash with Stamina Mastery uses Grapple and air jumps to get high above you, uses Death Slam on you followed by Ground Strike, then starts over
An enemy McGinnis fires a Spectral Wall that deploys behind you, then uses Heavy Barrage on you. She dashes away when you get within 10m of her, then starts over
An enemy Paradox moves and jumps around, charging Kinetic Carbine, shooting you with it and then hitting you with Paradoxical Swap every few seconds
An enemy Silver transforms with Lycan Curse and chases you, attacking with her claws, Mauling Leap, Go For The Throat and Tail Whack
An enemy Viscous moves and jumps around, then rolls after you with Goo Ball and starts over
An enemy Viscous moves and jumps around while using Puddle Punch under you at random intervals
Pick a drill for an enemy bot to run in front of you. Pick No Drill to stop

strings.new: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, Sleep, or Fear and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus {g:citadel_inline_attribute:'MoveSpeed'}
